reviewed_by: Hermes agent (monchobotjr) - agent reviewed, NOT human reviewed

scope.purpose: recover real Jina/DuckDuckGo snippets and add explicit, caller-supplied source/language ordering criteria
scope.not: not a relevance model, not a reranker, not a parity or superiority comparison, not a completeness measurement
scope.cli: criteria are exposed on execute_search()/execute_action() only; no CLI flag was added in this change

host.working_tree: modified (other workers editing backends.py, cli.py, extract.py, reach_backend.py)

snippet_fix.defect: _snippet_from_block stopped at the first blank line, but Jina Reader separates the result heading, the favicon/breadcrumb line and the snippet line with blank lines, so every snippet was empty
extraction_rules: the snippet is the link text of an inline markdown link line inside the block
the grey breadcrumb line is skipped (it equals the hit URL or its host+path)
the window stops at the next heading, so a block never borrows the next block's text
bold highlight markers (** / __), backslash escapes and the ¶ anchor glyph are removed; whitespace is collapsed; nothing is added, re-spaced or translated
a line that opens a markdown link/highlight but never closes it is a truncated response tail and is skipped, not used
text is capped at 300 characters, the same cap as before

rules.language_source: first path segment if it is an ISO 639-1 code, optionally with a region subtag
rules.language_host: otherwise leftmost host label when the host has >= 3 labels and the label is a recognised ISO 639-1 code
rules.language_codes: fixed frozenset in hermes_trailhead/search.py (_LANGUAGE_CODES); unknown codes yield no language
rules.language_match: url tag equals the request, or the url tag extends it with a region subtag (zh matches zh-cn); zh-hans never matches zh-cn (no script/region folding)
rules.source_match: requested host equal to the url host, or the url host is a subdomain of it; scheme, path, port and leading www. are stripped; no wildcards, no path matching
rules.precedence: language group first, domain group second, original backend order otherwise (stable sort)
rules.inactive_criteria: a criterion that was not supplied contributes nothing; both empty returns the backend order unchanged
rules.never_inferred: query text is never inspected for script or keywords; hit order is never changed unless the caller passes a criterion

gaps: agent reviewed, not human reviewed; three queries, nine hits per run
one engine served every call (jina_duckduckgo); ddg_lite and ddg_html opened the circuit, so results are engine-correlated

DuckDuckGo highlight spans that touch emit no separating space; the reader output therefore contains e.g. 'HTTPlibrary' and 'RequestsRequests'. Those strings are literal reader output and were not repaired
300-character cap cuts mid-word for the two Spanish 'docs.python.org/3' snippets
language tags are not folded: a request for zh-hans does not match a /zh-cn/ page
language detection is URL-shape only; a page whose language is only in its content is reported as URL language ''
the leftmost-host-label rule can read a brand label as a language on a three-label host
ordering is not scoring: no relevance value is produced, and extract's evidence.relevance stays 'unknown'
CLI exposure, fallback ordering and cross-engine comparisons were not exercised
